doc.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Musical family and early start
summary: His parents played piano, his sister bought his first instrument, and records played at home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well my father played a little piano, but just for himself. And my mother did too. And they just did it at home. But no, my father was a caterer. But my sister supported me for music, and she bought me my first instrument and stuff like that. My cousin used to play like drums in the Elks marching band and I used to see those drums. But music was around the house all the time. I mean records were playing all the time, so we always heard the music, so I was around it all the time, to listen to it.
